integrity: Analytical proof with independently executable exact-arithmetic reproducibility checks; no claim of independent validation or exhaustive bibliographic priority.
scientific_limitations: An exact increment identity and a Pell-sparse necessary condition are proved for all dimensions; equality is not globally classified beyond the exact finite check through dimension 10^100. Only homogeneous fourth Walsh projections and endpoint operator norms are treated. Prior source formulas are credited.
title: A zero-alignment law and Pell-sparse plateaus for the quartic Walsh projection
